_comment: Phase F2.1 — codex-twilight stick.json keeps only true held-item CMD overrides for the TF magic scepters (31002 = scepter_of_twilight, 31003 = scepter_of_life_drain). Entity-display overrides (31100+) and the F1.15 ItemDisplay-overlay path were dropped here when paired client renderers took over rendering of TF mobs (see PLAN_F2).
